text: Connects to remote servers over SSH with Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys, built on libssh and libssh2
quote: Supports Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys. It is built on top of libssh and libssh2.

text: Mosh keeps connections alive while moving between networks, e.g. home, train and office
quote: You can flawlessly jump from home, to the train, and then to the office thanks to Mosh. Blink is rock-solid connected all the way.

text: Connections stay intact after the device is put to sleep and woken up
quote: don't be afraid to put your device to sleep, when you wake it up later, your connections will be intact.

text: Mosh uses intelligent local echo to hide network lag, so typing feels local
quote: Mosh precludes network lag by performing intelligent local echo. _You can type as if you were in your local machine_.

text: Runs local UNIX commands such as cat, grep, wc, ls, cp, mv, mkdir, df and du
quote: cat, grep, wc, cd, setenv, ls, touch, cp, rm, ln, mv, mkdir, rmdir, df, du

text: Manages and edits files from the command line, checks the network and downloads files
quote: Manage and edit files from the command line, check on your network or download files.

text: Transfers files to and from remote hosts with scp and sftp
quote:
scp user@host.name.edu:filename . 
sftp localFilename user@host.name.edu:~/

text: Includes curl for ftp, http, scp and sftp transfers, using Blink's own key management
quote: curl opens access to file transfers to and from your iPad (ftp, http, scp, sftp...). It uses the key management of BLINKSHELL

text: Runs small Python or Lua scripts and supports shell redirection, but not pipes
quote: You can call commands individually, or use small scripts using python or lua. There is redirection (">", "<", "&>" ...), but no pipe.

text: Supports custom themes and fonts beyond the bundled ones, with Pragmata Pro included
quote: You can rock your terminal and roll your own themes and fonts beyond our included ones. And yes, we include Pragmata Pro by default!

text: Remaps keys on Bluetooth keyboards, e.g. Caps as Esc or Cmd as Ctrl
quote: Some like Caps as Esc on Vim, others Cmd as Ctrl on Emacs. _Blink champions them all_.

text: Lets users add keyboard shortcuts, modifier keys and custom key presses
quote: Keyboard: add shortcuts, modifier keys and custom key presses.

text: Shows available shortcuts when you hold the CMD key on a connected keyboard
quote: If you have a keyboard connected, press and hold `CMD ⌘` key to see available shortcuts.

text: Smart Keys add on-screen special keys and modifiers (CTRL, ALT, ESC) for key combinations
quote: Smart Keys provide special keys to use in your terminal session... Modifiers (i.e. CTRL ^, ALT ⌥, and ESC ⎋) for key combinations like CTRL+C.

text: Holding a modifier chains multiple key combinations, e.g. Emacs C-x and C-c
quote: Hold a modifier to chain multiple combinations, useful in applications like Emacs where you use chains like `C-x`, `C-c`.

text: Connects to VS Code for web, GitHub Codespaces, GitPod or your own VS Code server
quote: A coding experience fitted to your device, that connects to Microsoft Visual Studio Code for web, GitHub Codespaces, GitPod or your own VS Code server.

text: Blink Files lets you work on local projects or on remote machines
quote: Work on local projects, or seamlessly on remote machines thanks to Blink Files.

text: Opens a new shell with a two-finger tap and switches between active shells by swiping
quote: To create a new shell, tap the screen with two fingers. To switch between active shells, swipe side to side.

text: Saves hosts so you can connect using only the hostname
quote: Hosts: create hosts that can be accessed with only the hostname.

text: Generates SSH key pairs for more secure, password-less server access
quote: Keys: Create SSH key pairs for a more secure, password-less access to your servers.

text: Installs your keys on a server with ssh-copy-id after setting them up with config
quote: Run 'config' to setup your keys. Install them to a server through ssh-copy-id.

text: Supports SSH local tunnels (-L), ProxyCommand and ssh-agent
quote: Supports Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys... Including _tunnels_ (-L), _proxycommand_ and _ssh-agent_.

text: Selects text by tap-and-drag and drags text to or from other apps, pasting at the cursor
quote: You can drag selections to other apps, or from other apps into Blink. It will be pasted where the cursor is located.

text: Resizes the current terminal with a pinch gesture
quote: To adjust size of current terminal, pinch the screen 👌.

text: Supports iPad SplitView so you can use another app alongside the terminal
quote: We've incorporated SplitView, for those necessary Google searches and chats with coworkers.

text: Shows a full-resolution terminal on a 4K display connected to an iPad Pro
quote: Connect your iPad Pro to a 4K display and get a full resolution, crystal clear terminal.

text: Can display the terminal on a remote Apple TV
quote: Connect your iPad Pro to a 4K display and get a full resolution, crystal clear terminal... Blink can be displayed on a _remote Apple TV_ too!

text: A bar lets you create or close tabs, open Snips, and toggle Lock and Geo
quote: In the bar you can: Create or Close a tab, access Snips, and toggle Lock and Geo.

text: Users can build Blink themselves and install it on their iOS devices through Xcode
quote: We made a ton easier to build and install Blink yourself on your iOS devices through XCode.
